verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs say you can save insights to dashboards and "get alerted when they move" or "set alerts on the numbers that matter". PostHog AI can create alerts, and the MCP OAuth scopes include alert:read/write, so metric alerting is a real first-party capability. The pack does not show dashboard subscriptions (scheduled delivery of dashboards), and it does not say whether alerts detect abnormal moves or only fire on simple thresholds. missing for 10: dashboard subscription/scheduled delivery evidence, anomaly-detection (abnormal movement) evidence, alert configuration/notification-channel docs for insight alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
